description:
Post a tweet with a hero banner image to X/Twitter.

Provide either an image_url (fetched and attached) or banner_svg
(rendered to PNG and attached). Text supports the same markdown
formatting as post_tweet.

banner_svg.description: Self-contained SVG markup string, converted to PNG.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

image_url.description: URL of an image to attach to the tweet.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

text.description: Tweet content with optional markdown formatting.

name: excalibur_post_tweet_image
title: Post a tweet with an image
